comments: into this rule (same destination folder). 1767641148's original conditions used
'all' to require a from header to simultaneously contain both

address, confirmed 0/2000 real matches ever -- almost certainly meant to be 'any'.
Fixed to 'any', broadened to bare 'tesco.com' (covers mail./email./bare tesco.com)
and kept '@tesco.co.uk', and kept the 'Was this you?' subject exclusion applied
across all Tesco mail. Took priority 90 (was 100).
